backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature report mapping Teen Patti game requirements to frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of various frontend files for reference during build planning.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base layer and OKLCH theme variables defining light/dark UI colors and global styles.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry with Teen Patti PWA metadata, icons, and root mount point.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest declaring Teen Patti app metadata, icons, display mode, and categories.
frontend/public/offline.html: Offline fallback page styled with gradient theme and auto-reload when back online.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker caching Teen Patti assets with network-first fetch strategy and offline fallback.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app shell with header, About dialog, service worker registration, and TeenPattiGameShell mount.
frontend/src/components/AboutHelp.tsx: Displays help content for Teen Patti, including gameplay overview, disclaimers, rules, and features.
frontend/src/components/OnlineRequiredBl: Shows a blocking overlay when offline with a retry button to recheck connectivity.
frontend/src/components/PwaInstallInstru: Dialog providing manual PWA installation steps, mainly for Android Chrome, with explanations and a close button.
Dialog for sharing the game via native share, WhatsApp, or manual link copy with status alerts.
Reusable dialog content wrapper applying consistent styling, transitions, and layout.
frontend/src/game/controls/TouchControls: Mobile touch controls for left, right, and brake actions with pointer handling and cleanup.
frontend/src/game/controls/useGameContro: Global game control state with keyboard listeners and a React hook for subscribing to updates.
frontend/src/game/original/OriginalCanva: Canvas-based game loop that handles player movement, obstacle spawning, collision detection, scoring, and difficulty scaling.
frontend/src/game/original/OriginalGameS: Manages overall game states, score tracking, dialogs, and renders the canvas game and UI screens.
frontend/src/game/original/settings/defa: Defines default gameplay settings and difficulty presets for speed and spawn rate.
frontend/src/game/original/settings/useC: Hook that loads, updates, and persists custom game settings to localStorage.
frontend/src/game/original/types.ts: Contains shared game types including GameState, GameSettings, and GameStats.
frontend/src/game/original/ui/CreatorCon: Dialog UI for adjusting gameplay settings like difficulty, speed, and spawn rate.
frontend/src/game/original/ui/GameHud.ts: Displays the in-game HUD showing current score and high score.
frontend/src/game/original/ui/GameStartS: Start screen with game info, instructions, high score, and navigation actions.
frontend/src/game/original/ui/LegalOwner: Dialog presenting legal, ownership, and asset usage information.
frontend/src/game/scene/PlayerCarModel.t: Defines a 3D player car model using multiple Three.js meshes with textured and colored materials. Loads a car texture and constructs a detailed low-poly supercar body.
Implements the main 3D gameplay scene for a traffic-avoidance game, handling player movement, obstacle spawning, scoring, and roadside instanced meshes. Uses React Three Fiber and game state to update motion and collisions.
frontend/src/game/teenpatti/engine/ai.ts: Provides AI logic for Teen Patti, evaluating hand strength and deciding whether to fold, call, or raise. Uses randomness and hand evaluation to produce varied decisions.
frontend/src/game/teenpatti/engine/cards: Defines card types and utilities for creating, shuffling, and dealing a standard 52‑card deck. Supports basic rank lookup and hand distribution.
frontend/src/game/teenpatti/engine/gameS: Implements Teen Patti game state transitions including betting, folding, raising, calling, and showdown logic. Manages chip counts, pot updates, and winner assignment.
frontend/src/game/teenpatti/engine/handR: Evaluates Teen Patti hands, detecting ranks like trail, sequence, and flush, and compares two hands to determine the winner. Provides helper logic for straight, flush, and A‑2‑3 edge cases.
frontend/src/game/teenpatti/TeenPattiGam: Manages the Teen Patti game flow, including starting hands, player actions, AI responses, and showdown resolution. Renders appropriate UI screens and updates game state transitions.
frontend/src/game/teenpatti/ui/TeenPatti: UI component providing Fold, Call, and Raise controls with input handling for raise amounts.
Renders a Teen Patti playing card face-up or face-down with suit symbols and styling.
Displays the end-of-hand results including winner, hand evaluations, chip counts, and a play-again button.
Start screen showing game title, quick rules, chip notice, and buttons to begin or view rules.
Main table layout showing opponent, pot, player cards, chip counts, and the action bar during betting.
frontend/src/game/TrafficJamGame.tsx: Main game container handling game state, score, scene rendering, and online checks.
frontend/src/game/ui/CanvasErrorBoundary: Error boundary that catches render failures in canvas scenes and shows a retry fallback.
frontend/src/game/ui/GameHud.tsx: HUD for the TrafficJam game displaying score and a game-over overlay with restart option.
frontend/src/game/ui/SceneRenderFallback: Fallback screen explaining rendering issues and offering a retry button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages a backend actor based on user identity and invalidates dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements a React context/provider and hook for managing Internet Identity login, loading stored identities, and exposing login status helpers.
frontend/src/hooks/useOnlineStatus.ts: Provides a hook that tracks navigator online/offline status and allows manual rechecking.
frontend/src/hooks/usePwaInstall.ts: Handles PWA install prompts, tracks installability and status, and exposes an install function.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base layers and custom theme variables plus app-wide component styles for a game UI.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/utils/iframeNavigation.ts: Provides helpers for detecting iframe embedding and performing safe navigation or opening new tabs.
frontend/src/utils/shareUrl.ts: Creates sanitized shareable URLs by removing hash fragments to avoid leaking sensitive tokens.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, themes, animations, and plugins for the project.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata including state version, summary, constraints, issues, and required assets.
